zh.title: 泰国芭堤雅：两名中国女子遭绑架后获救
zh.summary: 泰国警方11月23日救出两名遭勒索赎金的中国女子，并拘捕一名中国籍嫌疑人。
zh.body: 据Khaosod English及Pattaya Mail报道，两名中国女子未按计划返回曼谷及中国，友人报警后，泰国警方于11月23日将二人安全救出并拘捕嫌疑人。报道所述赎金要求合计200万泰铢。案件进入司法调查。此次事件反映旅游城市内针对外籍人员的勒索风险，尤其是行程脱离既定安排后失联所产生的响应延迟。企业应将差旅人员错过约定联络或返程节点纳入异常升级机制，指定能够联系当地警方和领事机构的值班负责人，保存行程与紧急联系人资料。后续关注警方公布的指控、是否存在其他受害者以及案件与其他勒索网络的关联。来源：https://www.khaosodenglish.com/news/2026/11/24/two-chinese-women-kidnapped-by-chinese-man-in-pattaya/；https://www.pattayamail.com/news/pattaya-kidnap-suspect-turns-knife-on-himself-after-police-rescue-two-chinese-women-572938

en.title: Thailand: Two Chinese women rescued after kidnapping in Pattaya
en.summary: Thai police rescued two Chinese women on 23 November and detained a Chinese suspect in an alleged ransom case.
en.body: Khaosod English and Pattaya Mail reported that two Chinese women missed their planned return journey and were rescued by Thai police on 23 November after a friend reported their disappearance. The reported ransom demand totalled THB 2 million. A suspect was detained and the case is under investigation. The incident illustrates extortion exposure in a tourist destination and the response delay that can follow an unexplained deviation from travel plans. Employers should define escalation triggers for missed check-ins or return journeys, designate a duty contact able to reach local police and consular services, and retain itinerary and emergency contact information. Follow-up indicators include formal charges, additional victims and any documented links to other extortion networks. Sources: https://www.khaosodenglish.com/news/2026/11/24/two-chinese-women-kidnapped-by-chinese-man-in-pattaya/; https://www.pattayamail.com/news/pattaya-kidnap-suspect-turns-knife-on-himself-after-police-rescue-two-chinese-women-572938
